item.description: Feyenoord come from a goal to beat Como 3-2 in Rotterdam to secure their first win of the league phase in this season's Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Tresoldi hat-trick fires Club Brugge to victory over Inter in seven-goal thriller
item.description: Club Brugge's Nicolo Tresoldi scores a hat-trick as the Belgian side edge Inter Milan 4-3, extending Inter's Champions League losing run to four matches for the first time in their history. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Gordon scores as 'brilliant Barcelona' thrash Galatasaray
item.description: Anthony Gordon scores his first Champions League goal for Barcelona as the Spanish side come from behind to thrash Galatasaray 4-1 in Istanbul, and make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Viking snatch draw against Bayern Munich in six-goal thriller
item.description: Norwegian champions Viking score a 90th minute equaliser to snatch a 3-3 draw against six-time European champions Bayern Munich in the Champions League, securing one of the biggest results in the club's history. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Substitutes steal the show as Arsenal score three against Lille
item.description: Substitute Bukayo Saka scores one and sets up another to help Arsenal beat Lille 3-0 at the Emirates, as the Premier League champions made it two wins from two in the Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Yoro sent off as Man Utd stumble to defeat against Atletico Madrid
item.description: Manchester United's winless run stretches to five matches, as they're beaten 2-0 by Atletico Madrid in the Champions League, in a match which saw them concede in the opening minute before ending the game with ten men after Leny Yoro was sent off. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Brilliant Barcola scores first hat-trick to get lift-off at Liverpool
item.description: Liverpool's summer signing Bradley Barcola scores his first senior hat-trick, and his first goals for Liverpool, as he helps his side beat LASK 6-3 in Austria to make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Barcola shines as Liverpool score six to beat LASK
item.description: Bradley Barcola scores a hat-trick as Liverpool beat LASK 6-3 in Austria to make it two wins from two in the league phase of this season's Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: LIV accuses DP World Tour of player 'interference'
item.description: LIV Golf accuses the DP World Tour of a "clear attempt to interfere" with its restructuring process, after the European tour said it would refuse membership to anyone playing on the breakaway LIV circuit next season. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: On night of mayhem for Liverpool, Barcola arrives in style
item.description: Bradley Barcola's form was the subject of pre-match questions before Liverpool faced LASK - but the France forward's Champions League hat-trick was the perfect answer. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Infantino faces FIFA rebels in Zurich after failed World Cup stake sale
item.description: Gianni Infantino faces FIFA rebels after failed World Cup sale, while members to be offered $6.35bn development fund. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Aussie cyclists begin World Championships with silver medal
item.description: Australia reaches the podium in the men's team sprint at the UCI Track Cycling World Championships for the fifth consecutive time. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Barcola scores hat-trick as Liverpool hit LASK for six, Feyenoord beat Como
item.description: Following a move from Paris Saint-Germain, Bradley Barcola gets first Liverpool goals with Champions League hat-trick. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: OpenAI’s London staff receive average of £2.3m per person annually
item.description: Accounts for the Westminster-based company behind ChatGPT show that 110 staff shared £87m in salaries and £168m in shares last year OpenAI’s London staff each received £2,318,181 on average last year, as the ChatGPT-maker poured Premier League football salaries into its bid to dominate the global AI race. Accounts for OpenAI UK Ltd, which is based in Westminster but is opening a new HQ in London’s King’s Cross area, showed that 110 staff shared £87m in salaries and £168m in shares in the company, which is aiming to list on the stock market at a valuation of about $1tn. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: ParaMatildas hunt more Australian football history at World Cup
item.description: Having won Australia's first-ever round ball World Cup in 2024, the ParaMatildas begin the 2026 tournament in uncharted territory for an Australian football team and with the world's best "plotting" against them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Cokayne back as England face Canada threat in Toronto
item.description: England welcome back the experience of Amy Cokayne at hooker as their 41-match unbeaten run comes under serious threat away to Canada. Fuente: BBC Sport.
